title: Structure-based design and optimization of cyclic peptide ligands targeting delta-like ligand 3
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,24218-24223
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02966C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Xinyan Gao, Xiaochuan Zha, Wenhao Liu, Jiale Xie, Jian Gao, Zonghua Luo
Introducing a rigid cyclopropane mimic at a key valine residue yielded B5, a high-affinity cyclic peptide (KD = 12.3 nM) targeting DLL3, providing a potential DLL3-targeted theranostic scaffold.
